messages:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: service=runtime-contbatch region=us-west-2 metric=p99_latency value=1820ms threshold=1200ms — paging oncall
Mira: @Sam oncall here, I'm pulling graphs. seeing p95 ~420ms, p99 jumping to ~1.8s for the streaming path. definitely SLO breach. :eyes:
Sam: on it. any recent deploys to batcher? what changed in scheduling?
Mira: no prod deploys in last 2 hours per deploy-bot. but I see a surge in mixed-seq requests from a single customer group (~20% of requests) — seqlen distribution shift to long tails.
Jia: I can confirm. KV cache hit rate dropped ~15% at the same time, looks like cache churn from big sequences. logs show packer creating oversized batches (~batch=64) that block streaming lanes.
Mira: hypothesis: packing+fairshare scheduling is creating head-of-line blocking — large packed batches delaying small streaming requests -> tail latency.
Ravi: CS note: we have a few paying customers with latency-sensitive streaming features—RallyApp reported client-side stalls around the same time. flagged for potential customer impact.
Hiten: tagging SRE runbook: set incident severity to SEV2 unless customer reports production outage. I recommend live mitigation: reduce max_pack_size, promote preemptive-shed mode for streaming routes.
Nadia: how fast can we flip configs? There is a runtime flag `--pack-max=64` currently. we could lower to 8. risk?
Sam: lowering pack max to 8 reduces packing efficiency but should unblock stream lanes. prepare rollback plan.
Jia: prepping a runtime toggle. command: 
```
# reduce pack size on fleet (staged)
rdctl runtime config set --scope=usw2 --name=pack_max --value=8 --rolling
```
Jia: will stage to 10% pods first, then 50% in 2m, then global if metrics look good.
Mira: while Jia stages, let's also enable `preemptive_stream_priority=true` on the scheduler to allow streaming to preempt large batches. Jia, can you include that toggle in the same rollout?
Jia: yes, adding `preemptive_stream_priority=true`. launching now.
OpsBot: deployment started: rdctl rollout id=roll-1799991110-1 user=Jia targets=usw2 percent=10
Sam: watching traces. set alert to p99 1200ms and paging thresholds. I'll also add a temporary rate limit for the noisy customer group (10 qps) to reduce churn.
Mira: command to add rate-limit: `ratelimitctl set --customer RallyApp --qps 10` — I'm applying that as well.
Ravi: informing customer: "We've detected brief stalls and are making configuration changes to reduce latency. We will follow up with a root cause summary." will update CS channel.
Hiten: good. also pin a Grafana dashboard to this thread: contbatch/p99, pack_size, kv_cache_hit, streaming_inflight.
Jia: 10% rollout finished. preliminary signals: pack_size 95th dropped, kv cache hit recovered slightly, p99 down to ~1.1s. continuing to 50%.
Mira: can we test preemption metrics? any signs of starvation for big-batch workloads?
Sam: so far throughput dip ~6% for long-tail batch customers, but within tolerances for now. priority is stability. continue rollout.
Jia: 50% done. p99 now ~760ms, p95 ~390ms. moving to 100% after 2m observation window.
OpsBot: rollout completed: roll-1799991110-1 status=success duration=4m35s
Sam: completed. disabling rate limit on RallyApp now? keep for 30m then remove if stable.
Mira: keep it. schedule follow-up: postmortem + action items: 1) improve packer heuristics to avoid oversizing when seqlen variance high, 2) KV cache eviction tuning when mixed-seq detected, 3) add automated canary for packer regressions, 4) update runbook with preemptive_stream_priority as mitigation.
Ravi: CS will collect customer timestamps and impact window for notification.
Hiten: nice work team. tagging oncall-next: @Nadia for handoff in 30m. add owners for each action item.
Nadia: acknowledged, I'll take handoff and own the follow-ups. adding to my todo list. :thumbsup:
Mira: incident closed for live mitigation — add to incidents channel postmortem when we finish RCA. thanks everyone."
